issuer: the Mississippi Department of Public Safety, Driver Service Bureau
note: The Driver Service Bureau's fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives an 8-year regular Class R licence at $47.00 (4 years $24.00) and an 8-year identification card at $33.00 (each fee printed before its description). Its Class R page says the minimum age for a licence is 16, so the licence is kept from 16; Mississippi also has an intermediate licence for young drivers whose terms weren't read (worth checking). No youngest age for the card was read.
